subject: AssembleNet status: repro done, memory is the deciding factor
body:
Hi Lucia, Santiago,

Status. Repro is done on the found architectures. AssembleNet++ with peer-attention beats our current hand-designed backbone by 3.2 points top-1 on the internal action set, and AssembleNet (no peer-attention) by 1.9.

Risk, and it's the practical one: AssembleNet++ at full width does not fit our serving GPUs. AssembleNet++Lite exists precisely for this — it's the lighter version made to fit better in GPU memory — and it retains 2.4 of the 3.2 points at roughly 40% of the activation memory. My read is Lite is the only variant with a path to production; full ++ is a research artifact for us.

All benchmark runs are scheduled to finish June 18, ahead of the Vulcan maintenance window.

Yusuf
